observations: The event digest bug confirmed ORCH-D8 and ORCH-D29 must remain distinct representations joined by explicit validation; their candidate definitions already state that boundary.
The atomic file state realizes ORCH-D35 for the local edition but does not prove cross-process or power-loss guarantees beyond the documented mechanism.
Lease, fence, recovery, and capacity behavior fit ORCH-D41 through ORCH-D44 and ORCH-D50 without wording changes.

M5 exposed that graph_digest alone did not make the Run Bundle content-addressed as ORCH-D3 requires. bundle_digest and admission_context now cover the full immutable envelope without changing the candidate definition.

known_limits: Single logical writer is assumed; there is no cross-process file lock.
Filesystem sync mechanics are exercised functionally, not through induced power loss.
Worker API is typed Rust; HTTP/gRPC surfaces remain M6.
claim_ceiling: M4 local runtime evidence only; no remote security, production durability, definition promotion, product approval, legacy deletion, release, deployment, publication, or authority effect.
